title: P2755 - P2755
models: Audi A3 / VW Golf / Seat Leon
Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
symptoms: Stalling, no-start, no communication to control module(s)
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri or power supply to/from N82, N509, or N488 faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  N82, N509, or N488
Kontrol edin:  for applicable recalls or TPIs related to N82 failure resulting in coolant migration thorough the N82 solenoid connector resting in destroyed wiring harness(es)
